keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «태양광과 풍력은 늘 전기를 만들지 못한다(문제)» 와 «전기를 저장하고 공급을 맞추는 방법을 찾아야 한다(해결책)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (solar and wind do not produce power all the time) and the solution (finding ways to store power and balance supply). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: They release almost no greenhouse gases, and sunlight and wind are free
They do not produce power all the time
Store power with batteries, pumped hydro, and connected grids

qs.q: Why does connecting power grids across wide areas help?
qs.qko: 왜 넓은 지역의 전력망을 연결하면 도움이 될까요?
opts: The wind may be blowing in one region while it is calm in another.
It makes the wind turbines spin faster.
It stops cloudy days from happening.
evs: Once panels and turbines are built, sunlight and wind are also free.
Large batteries can save extra electricity on sunny or windy days and release it later.
Connecting power grids across wide areas also helps, since the wind may be blowing in one region while it is calm in another.
Solar and wind power are often praised as the energy sources of the future.
why: 한 지역은 바람이 불고 다른 지역은 잔잔할 수 있어서, 연결하면 서로 전기를 나눌 수 있다고 했어요.
The wind may be blowing in one region while it is calm in another, so connected grids can share power.

qs.q: In "whether the weather cooperates or not," what does "cooperates" mean?
qs.qko: «whether the weather cooperates or not» 에서 «cooperates» 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
opts: gives the sunlight or wind needed to make power
evs: They produce electricity without burning fuel, so they release almost no greenhouse gases while operating.
Solar panels generate nothing at night and less on cloudy days, and wind turbines slow down when the wind is calm.
These solutions are becoming cheaper, but they still require major investment.
As storage technology improves, solar and wind can supply a larger share of the world's electricity.
why: 바로 앞 문장에서 밤이나 흐린 날, 바람이 잔잔한 날에는 전기가 적게 나온다고 했어요. 날씨가 «협조한다» 는 것은 햇빛이나 바람을 충분히 준다는 뜻이에요.
The sentence before says panels make nothing at night and turbines slow on calm days, so the weather "cooperates" when it gives enough sun or wind.

qs.q: Why is storing power the key to relying on solar and wind?
qs.qko: 왜 전기를 저장하는 것이 태양광과 풍력에 의지하는 열쇠일까요?
opts: They do not make power all the time, but people need electricity every hour.
Batteries burn fuel to make extra electricity.
evs: However, these sources have an important weakness: they do not produce power all the time.
Once panels and turbines are built, sunlight and wind are also free.
Yet people need electricity every hour, whether the weather cooperates or not.
Pumped hydro storage uses surplus power to pump water uphill, then lets it flow down through turbines when demand rises.
why: 태양광과 풍력은 늘 전기를 만들지 못하는데, 사람들은 매시간 전기가 필요해요. 그래서 남는 전기를 저장해야 해요.
Solar and wind do not produce power all the time, yet people need electricity every hour, so power must be stored.

ends: Find out how giant batteries store power for a whole city.
거대한 배터리가 도시 전체의 전기를 어떻게 저장하는지 알아봐요.
Learn how countries share electricity through connected grids.
나라들이 연결된 전력망으로 전기를 어떻게 나누는지 알아봐요.

write.src: “I want to <u>put solar panels on our school roof</u> because <u>sunlight is free once the panels are built</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «하고 싶은 일 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you want to do and your reason in English.

write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가/무엇이 + 어떻게 한다» 를 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because the sun gives free energy)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who or what + what it does to make your reason clear. (e.g. because the sun gives free energy)
